summary: Rescan of the same top-3000 golden seeds with the round-2 polished champion (panel median 4156, -10.8% vs BC): fastest 1365 ticks = 13.65 s - WORSE than the unpolished BC's 1179 (11.79 s) - while win rate rose 98.2% -> 99.8% (2993/3000). CAMPAIGN LESSON (mean-tail tradeoff): a modest timepolish buys consistency (win rate up, median down) and can SELL tail sharpness - the BC's fastest line used 16 shots, the polished model's 24. Large polishes (J1/J2/jungle6) improved both; small ones may not. RECORD-HUNTING and FULL-RUN champions are therefore separate titles: Jungle3's AI-TAS best stands with the BC at 11.79 s; the expected-time champion is the round-2 final model.
